answer: Sybil resistance has to cost the attacker more than the reward is worth. Sponsor bonds: a newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with 63 POA, slashed in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 16 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 63 POA on a stranger. The register is public, so a sponsor's whole recruit list is visible. The atlas test is the live device, the nadir test is the locked stake, and the karst test is the graded history no template can fake. The math, not the moderators, does the filtering.
